claim: A DXT texture whose top level is not a multiple of 4 draws: DXT1 and DXT5 loading pictures at 4802x3002 fill the loading screen, so the upscaler's round-up to 4 was not needed for this class of file
notes: run 2026-11-06_j96 r1: ui\loading_screen_pictures\default_landbattle.dds (DXT5, land_small load) and 6.dds (DXT1, campaign_start load), solid colours, full chains, seen in grab.ps1 frames. Two files in one screen, a full-screen image. Not proven for the other five affected files: the seven DXT files of ui\frontend ui\loadingscreen drew no marker at aligned sizes either (run load), though their art is on that screen (J96 review round 1, 2026-11-06: the shot shows these vanilla files, whose only copy is in boot.pack; raw/load/proxy.log indexes all seven entries), so a movie-pack entry did not replace them, cause not proven, and the heading at 1154x382 proves nothing. The flags' large.dds at 1282x642 were not seen on any screen shot. The rule in upscale/core/rules.py stays: it is harmless and D3D9 documents the limit.
